propositions: Implement blue-green atomic pointer-swap autodeploy for MCP target on origin/main changes without killing in-flight certified ops

Start immutable docker container on free A/B port, health-check /health endpoint within timeout, atomically flip nginx upstream include via atomic rename, then gracefully retire old container via SIGTERM self-drain
Pre-check available memory (MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo) before building new container; abort with AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT if below MCP_MEM_MIN_MB threshold
Detect MCP-only changes in MCP_PATHS; trigger mcp target independently and prevent redundant review-bot rebuild on MCP-only diffs
Manage container port pool (8091, 8092, 8093) via blue-green A/B selection; emit AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP and backoff if both ports bound by un-reclaimable in-flight containers
Run graceful retirement sweep in background (closes inherited flock FD) to reap exited containers without blocking the deploy tick or blocking subsequent deploys
